home.eyebrow: Engineer by day // Author at play
home.intro: Easily distracted by cats, birds, and ...
paragraphs: I’m Zack and I live in sunny Lakeland, Florida.
I made this site to promote my creative works, scream into the void, and share stuff that inspires me.
aboutParagraphs: I live with my beautiful wife, Jennifer, and our three cats: Chemi, Tashi, and Brave.
My favorite hobby is learning new hobbies.
home.editorialLabel: Editorial kitty committee aka firing squad

aboutSections.heading: The engineering part
paragraphs: I’m a Senior Manufacturing Industrial Engineer at Publix in Lakeland, Florida, and a Lean Six Sigma Black Belt. I graduated from the University of Florida in 2012 with a B.S. in Chemical Engineering, cum laude.
My work is about understanding how things run, finding the right problem to solve, and making systems work better for the people using them.

aboutSections.heading: The writing part
paragraphs: Making things has always mattered to me. Drawing, music, model kits, stories. Engineering became my career; fiction is something I’m choosing to give room to as well.
I’m writing my first novel and learning as I go. I’m drawn to strange worlds, found family, and stories that leave room for humor even when things get dark.

aboutSections.heading: The home part
paragraphs: I live in Lakeland with my wife, Jennifer, and our cats Chemi, Tashi, and Brave. There’s usually music playing, something I’m building, or a bird outside worth getting distracted by.
